judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Plain words and the deaf-old-man gag have some Nox flavour, but the neat two-way branching to the same boat, the tidy proof-of-kill bargain, the set-up/pay-off joke ('No need to shout, I can hear you fine!') and the '--' dash feel built by a modern designer; Nox's campaign has no such boat-to-the-island fork.
